paraphrase: Proposes tiered receipts for paid agent work: low-risk drafts get cheap format/provenance checks; money-moving or buyer-facing milestones get expensive, full verification. Not maximal proof on every step.

claims.text: Agent work receipts should be tiered by risk: cheap checks for low-consequence, full proofs for high-consequence

evaluation.notes: Practical tiering approach. Similar to panaiassistant's three-tier model.
